### Storia dell'arte e culture

Groups: 14 · Skills: 59

[artHistoryAndCultures.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artHistoryAndCultures/artHistoryAndCultures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Artworks and artistic practices develop within particular communities, historical debates, patrons and material technologies. Study of art history distinguishes movements and named traditions through their own works and contexts rather than treating an entire continent or historical era as a single skill. **User-friendly description (it):** Studia tradizioni artistiche diverse, legate a specifiche comunità dell'Africa occidentale e centrale.

##### Analizzare le placche della corte del Benin

[analyzeBeninCourtPlaques.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artHistoryAndCultures/westAndCentralAfricanTraditions/skills/analyzeBeninCourtPlaques.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how Edo court plaques convey royal authority, hierarchy and historical events through relief imagery and material choices.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esamina come le placche della corte del Benin rappresentano l'autorità, le persone e gli avvenimenti.

##### Analizzare le tradizioni delle mascherate Gelede

[analyzeGeledeMasqueradeTraditions.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artHistoryAndCultures/westAndCentralAfricanTraditions/skills/analyzeGeledeMasqueradeTraditions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret mask form, costume, performance and community functions in Yoruba Gelede contexts rather than treating the mask as an isolated sculpture.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come maschere, costumi e spettacoli Gelede yoruba si combinano nella vita delle comunità.

##### Analizzare le figure nkisi del Kongo

[analyzeKongoNkisiFigures.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artHistoryAndCultures/westAndCentralAfricanTraditions/skills/analyzeKongoNkisiFigures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate the formal and material features of particular Kongo power figures to the culturally situated purposes and practices associated with them.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora i materiali e i ruoli culturali delle figure nkisi del Kongo.

### Comprensione e critica dell'arte

Groups: 4 · Skills: 18

[artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpretation of artistic work depends on the medium, formal relationships, intentions and cultural contexts. This field supports attentive analysis of existing artworks rather than instruction in a particular material technique.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come le scelte artistiche e il contesto culturale ci aiutano a comprendere e discutere le opere.

#### Curatela e presentazione

Skills: 4

[curationAndPresentation.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/curationAndPresentation/curationAndPresentation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Exhibiting work creates new relationships between artworks, their physical arrangement and audience access, independent of authoring the artworks.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come la scelta e l'esposizione delle opere d'arte modificano l'esperienza del pubblico.

##### Analizzare il contesto espositivo

[analyzeDisplayContext.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/curationAndPresentation/skills/analyzeDisplayContext.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how scale, lighting, placement and accompanying labels affect reception.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come illuminazione, dimensioni, posizione e didascalie influenzano la presentazione di un'opera.

##### Selezionare opere per una mostra

[selectWorksForAnExhibition.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/curationAndPresentation/skills/selectWorksForAnExhibition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Choose a coherent set of works in response to a theme, audience and available space.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scegli opere d'arte che dialoghino tra loro in relazione a un tema e a un pubblico specifici.

##### Organizzare il percorso di una mostra

[sequenceAnExhibition.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/curationAndPresentation/skills/sequenceAnExhibition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Arrange works to create purposeful contrasts, transitions or thematic developments.

**User-friendly description (it):** Disponi le opere in un ordine che crei collegamenti e contrasti significativi.

##### Scrivere testi interpretativi per una mostra

[writeExhibitionInterpretationText.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/curationAndPresentation/skills/writeExhibitionInterpretationText.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Communicate accurate context without forcing one mandatory emotional or symbolic interpretation.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scrivi didascalie utili che offrano un contesto senza imporre al pubblico cosa provare.

#### Linguaggio formale dell'arte

Skills: 5

[formalLanguage.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/formalLanguage/formalLanguage.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Formal choices direct perception and establish relationships within a work. Analysis here is cross-medium rather than the execution of a technical medium-specific method.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come linee, colori, forme e altri elementi guidano la nostra esperienza dell'arte.

##### Analizzare il ritmo artistico

[analyzeArtisticRhythm.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/formalLanguage/skills/analyzeArtisticRhythm.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify significant repetition, variation or pacing in images, movement or sound.

**User-friendly description (it):** Individua schemi ricorrenti e variazioni nel ritmo di immagini, suoni o movimenti.

##### Analizzare le relazioni tra i colori

[analyzeColorRelationships.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/formalLanguage/skills/analyzeColorRelationships.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate hue, value, saturation and juxtaposition to mood, contrast or visual emphasis in existing art.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come gli accostamenti di colori influenzano l'atmosfera, il contrasto e l'attenzione.

##### Analizzare la composizione

[analyzeComposition.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/formalLanguage/skills/analyzeComposition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how placement, hierarchy, scale and balance guide a viewer through a work.

**User-friendly description (it):** Osserva come gli artisti usano la disposizione, le dimensioni e l'equilibrio per dirigere la tua attenzione.

##### Analizzare linee e forme

[analyzeLineAndShape.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/formalLanguage/skills/analyzeLineAndShape.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how contours, directional marks and organic or geometric shapes structure a visual work.

**User-friendly description (it):** Nota come linee e forme guidano lo sguardo e organizzano un'immagine.

##### Analizzare texture e superfici

[analyzeTextureAndSurface.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/formalLanguage/skills/analyzeTextureAndSurface.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish material texture from its visual depiction and explain its perceptual or expressive effect.

**User-friendly description (it):** Osserva le texture reali e rappresentate e come modificano la percezione di un'opera d'arte.

#### Forme e finalità dell'arte

Skills: 4

[formsAndPurposes.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/formsAndPurposes/formsAndPurposes.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Art can represent, express, question, commemorate or invite participation; genre labels and purposes are useful but not universal classifications.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora i molti modi in cui l'arte può comunicare idee, emozioni ed esperienze.

##### Classificare i generi artistici

[classifyArtisticGenres.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/formsAndPurposes/skills/classifyArtisticGenres.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use established formal conventions to distinguish genres while allowing for hybrid works and evolving traditions.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci i generi artistici più comuni, notando anche le opere che li mescolano o li mettono in discussione.

##### Distinguere i mezzi espressivi artistici

[distinguishArtisticMedia.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/formsAndPurposes/skills/distinguishArtisticMedia.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify how sound, image, movement, language or physical space contributes to an artwork's mode of expression.

**User-friendly description (it):** Osserva come immagini, suoni, movimento, parole e spazi comunicano nelle diverse forme d'arte.

##### Distinguere rappresentazione e astrazione

[distinguishRepresentationAndAbstraction.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/formsAndPurposes/skills/distinguishRepresentationAndAbstraction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how a work may depict recognizable subjects, transform them or rely on nonrepresentational relationships.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora la differenza tra raffigurare soggetti riconoscibili e usare forme astratte.

##### Interpretare l'intenzione artistica

[interpretArtisticIntent.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/formsAndPurposes/skills/interpretArtisticIntent.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer plausible aims from artistic choices, distinguishing supported observations from assumptions about the creator.

**User-friendly description (it):** Usa gli indizi presenti in un'opera per esplorare ciò che il suo autore potrebbe aver voluto esprimere.

#### Interpretazione e valutazione

Skills: 5

[interpretationAndEvaluation.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/interpretationAndEvaluation/interpretationAndEvaluation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Judgments about art become more useful when observable evidence, contextual claims and chosen evaluative criteria are stated separately.

**User-friendly description (it):** Impara a discutere i possibili significati di un'opera usando prove e criteri chiari.

##### Confrontare interpretazioni artistiche

[compareArtisticInterpretations.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/interpretationAndEvaluation/skills/compareArtisticInterpretations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how different plausible readings explain the same evidence and where each is limited.

**User-friendly description (it):** Confronta diverse letture di un'opera e gli elementi che sostengono ciascuna interpretazione.

##### Descrivere le opere d'arte con precisione

[describeArtworksPrecisely.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/interpretationAndEvaluation/skills/describeArtworksPrecisely.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Report recognizable features and formal relationships before advancing an account of their meaning.

**User-friendly description (it):** Descrivi i dettagli che puoi davvero vedere o sentire prima di spiegarne il significato.

##### Distinguere osservazione e interpretazione

[distinguishObservationFromInterpretation.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/interpretationAndEvaluation/skills/distinguishObservationFromInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate directly perceptible details from symbolic, emotional or biographical inferences.

**User-friendly description (it):** Distingui ciò che osservi dal significato che gli attribuisci.

##### Valutare l'arte secondo criteri

[evaluateArtUsingCriteria.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/interpretationAndEvaluation/skills/evaluateArtUsingCriteria.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply explicit standards appropriate to a work's purpose without treating personal taste as universal fact.

**User-friendly description (it):** Valuta un'opera usando criteri chiari e coerenti con i suoi obiettivi, non soltanto con i tuoi gusti.

##### Motivare un'interpretazione artistica

[supportAnArtisticInterpretation.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/interpretationAndEvaluation/skills/supportAnArtisticInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Defend a reading with identifiable artistic decisions and context relevant to the work.

**User-friendly description (it):** Usa particolari dell'opera per spiegare e sostenere la tua interpretazione.

### Danza e coreografia

Groups: 3 · Skills: 15

[danceAndChoreography.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/danceAndChoreography/danceAndChoreography.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Dance organizes bodily movement as expressive and culturally situated form. Its aim is choreographic communication rather than athletic conditioning.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come il movimento espressivo, gli schemi di movimento e le tradizioni culturali danno vita alla danza.

#### Coreografia

Skills: 5

[choreography.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/danceAndChoreography/choreography/choreography.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Movement motifs and their transformations create deliberate time-space relationships among dancers.

**User-friendly description (it):** Crea e trasforma sequenze di movimento per comporre una danza completa.

##### Creare una coreografia sulla musica

[choreographToMusic.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/danceAndChoreography/choreography/skills/choreographToMusic.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate movement phrases to music's accents, rhythms or structural contrasts.

**User-friendly description (it):** Abbina i movimenti ai ritmi, agli accenti e ai cambiamenti musicali.

##### Creare un motivo di movimento

[createAMovementMotif.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/danceAndChoreography/choreography/skills/createAMovementMotif.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Develop a short distinctive sequence suitable for reuse or transformation.

**User-friendly description (it):** Inventa una breve sequenza riconoscibile di movimenti di danza.

##### Progettare formazioni di danza

[designDanceFormations.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/danceAndChoreography/choreography/skills/designDanceFormations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Coordinate dancers' positions and changing distances to establish purposeful spatial patterns.

**User-friendly description (it):** Pianifica come i danzatori si muovono insieme e creano figure nello spazio.

##### Strutturare una composizione coreografica

[structureADanceComposition.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/danceAndChoreography/choreography/skills/structureADanceComposition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Combine phrases through development, repetition and contrast across a complete work.

**User-friendly description (it):** Organizza le sequenze di danza usando ripetizione, contrasto e sviluppo.

##### Variare un motivo di movimento

[varyAMovementMotif.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/danceAndChoreography/choreography/skills/varyAMovementMotif.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Transform a recognizable phrase through timing, scale, direction or body-part choices.

**User-friendly description (it):** Trasforma un'idea di movimento cambiando direzione, ampiezza, velocità o posizione del corpo.

#### Linguaggio del movimento

Skills: 5

[movementLanguage.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/danceAndChoreography/movementLanguage/movementLanguage.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Bodily alignment, energy, pathways and temporal decisions distinguish expressive movement from simply moving between points.

**User-friendly description (it):** Usa la posizione del corpo, l'energia, lo spazio e il tempo per dare forma al movimento espressivo.

##### Controllare l'allineamento del corpo nel movimento

[controlMovementAlignment.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/danceAndChoreography/movementLanguage/skills/controlMovementAlignment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Coordinate body parts to create an intentional line and quality of movement in a dance form.

**User-friendly description (it):** Posiziona intenzionalmente le parti del corpo per creare linee di danza ben definite.

##### Coordinare la danza con il battito musicale

[coordinateDanceWithPulse.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/danceAndChoreography/movementLanguage/skills/coordinateDanceWithPulse.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate bodily movement to a chosen rhythmic reference while preserving movement intent.

**User-friendly description (it):** Sincronizza i movimenti con il battito musicale senza perdere espressività.

##### Eseguire una frase di danza

[performADancePhrase.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/danceAndChoreography/movementLanguage/skills/performADancePhrase.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect movements into a coherent phrase with expressive continuity.

**User-friendly description (it):** Unisci i movimenti in una sequenza fluida e intenzionale.

##### Utilizzare i livelli spaziali

[useSpatialLevels.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/danceAndChoreography/movementLanguage/skills/useSpatialLevels.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Move deliberately among high, middle and low positions and spatial pathways.

**User-friendly description (it):** Muoviti intenzionalmente tra posizioni alte, medie e basse.

##### Variare le dinamiche del movimento

[varyMovementDynamics.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/danceAndChoreography/movementLanguage/skills/varyMovementDynamics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Change weight, force, continuity or sharpness to express different qualities.

**User-friendly description (it):** Modifica forza, peso e fluidità dei movimenti per esprimere qualità diverse.

#### Tradizioni e interpretazione

Skills: 5

[traditionsAndInterpretation.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/danceAndChoreography/traditionsAndInterpretation/traditionsAndInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Dance forms have social and historical purposes that must be understood on their own cultural terms.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora il significato e il contesto culturale delle diverse tradizioni di danza.

##### Adattare responsabilmente i movimenti tradizionali

[adaptTraditionalMovementResponsibly.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/danceAndChoreography/traditionsAndInterpretation/skills/adaptTraditionalMovementResponsibly.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Transform source material with attention to permission, context and attribution.

**User-friendly description (it):** Rielabora i movimenti tradizionali rispettandone le origini e i significati.

##### Analizzare la danza nel contesto culturale

[analyzeDanceInCulturalContext.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/danceAndChoreography/traditionsAndInterpretation/skills/analyzeDanceInCulturalContext.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect a particular dance's forms to its community, occasion and transmission.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora i legami di una danza con la comunità e l'occasione in cui viene eseguita.

##### Distinguere i generi di danza

[distinguishDanceGenres.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/danceAndChoreography/traditionsAndInterpretation/skills/distinguishDanceGenres.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify conventions of specific social, folk, concert or contemporary dance forms.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci come i diversi stili di danza utilizzano movimenti e convenzioni sociali.

##### Valutare un'esibizione di danza

[evaluateDancePerformance.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/danceAndChoreography/traditionsAndInterpretation/skills/evaluateDancePerformance.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess a work through stated expressive and technical criteria rather than preference alone.

**User-friendly description (it):** Discuti un'esibizione di danza usando criteri artistici e tecnici chiari.

##### Interpretare il movimento espressivo

[interpretExpressiveMovement.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/danceAndChoreography/traditionsAndInterpretation/skills/interpretExpressiveMovement.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Support a reading of movement choices using dynamics, space and phrasing.

**User-friendly description (it):** Usa i dettagli del movimento per spiegare ciò che una danza potrebbe esprimere.

### Design e comunicazione visiva

Groups: 5 · Skills: 22

[designAndVisualCommunication.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/designAndVisualCommunication/designAndVisualCommunication.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Design communicates through typography, symbols, layout, applied graphics and wearable forms. In clothing, artistic choices also concern silhouette, fabric behavior and the body; industrial manufacturing and commercial strategy remain outside this domain.

**User-friendly description (it):** Usa forme, parole, immagini e materiali per comunicare idee attraverso il design.

#### Grafica applicata

Skills: 4

[appliedGraphics.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/designAndVisualCommunication/appliedGraphics/appliedGraphics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Packaging, editorial designs and pictograms require visual decisions constrained by surfaces or public information.

**User-friendly description (it):** Progetta elementi grafici per confezioni, pubblicazioni e informazioni rivolte al pubblico.

##### Verificare l'accessibilità visiva

[checkVisualAccessibility.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/designAndVisualCommunication/appliedGraphics/skills/checkVisualAccessibility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Revise barriers arising from low contrast, inappropriate text scale or color-only distinctions.

**User-friendly description (it):** Individua e correggi ostacoli visivi come il contrasto insufficiente o le indicazioni basate soltanto sui colori.

##### Progettare una famiglia di pittogrammi

[designAPictogramFamily.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/designAndVisualCommunication/appliedGraphics/skills/designAPictogramFamily.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Create related signs that are both mutually consistent and distinguishable.

**User-friendly description (it):** Progetta una serie di simboli visivamente coerenti ma facili da distinguere.

##### Progettare una doppia pagina editoriale

[designAnEditorialSpread.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/designAndVisualCommunication/appliedGraphics/skills/designAnEditorialSpread.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate text, image and whitespace across a composed reading surface.

**User-friendly description (it):** Disponi testi, immagini e spazi vuoti su una pagina o su una doppia pagina.

##### Progettare la grafica di una confezione

[designPackagingGraphics.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/designAndVisualCommunication/appliedGraphics/skills/designPackagingGraphics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Arrange images and information on a package so visual hierarchy remains intelligible.

**User-friendly description (it):** Organizza elementi grafici e informazioni sulla confezione secondo una gerarchia visiva chiara.

#### Design della moda e dell'abbigliamento

Skills: 6

[fashionAndApparelDesign.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/designAndVisualCommunication/fashionAndApparelDesign/fashionAndApparelDesign.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Garment design applies artistic decisions to forms worn on the body. Silhouette, material behavior, construction planning and coordinated collections distinguish this practice from textile-surface ornament and theatre-specific costume design.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come la forma del capo, il tessuto e i dettagli trasformano un'idea di moda in un indumento.

##### Progettare le silhouette degli abiti

[designGarmentSilhouettes.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/designAndVisualCommunication/fashionAndApparelDesign/skills/designGarmentSilhouettes.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Develop a clothing form through deliberate decisions about outline, volume and proportion in relation to the moving human body.

**User-friendly description (it):** Definisci il contorno e il volume di un indumento in relazione a un corpo in movimento.

##### Progettare i dettagli decorativi dei capi

[designGarmentSurfaceDetails.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/designAndVisualCommunication/fashionAndApparelDesign/skills/designGarmentSurfaceDetails.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Place trims, motifs or decorative features in relation to garment shape, seams and movement rather than designing an isolated textile repeat.

**User-friendly description (it):** Disponi i dettagli decorativi in modo che si armonizzino con la forma e il movimento di un indumento.

##### Sviluppare una collezione di moda

[developAFashionCollection.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/designAndVisualCommunication/fashionAndApparelDesign/skills/developAFashionCollection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Create a coherent series of garment designs that explores a shared expressive concept through intentional variations of silhouette, material or detail.

**User-friendly description (it):** Progetta una serie coordinata di proposte d'abbigliamento, con variazioni studiate.

##### Disegnare cartamodelli

[draftGarmentPatterns.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/designAndVisualCommunication/fashionAndApparelDesign/skills/draftGarmentPatterns.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Translate a proposed three-dimensional clothing form into two-dimensional pattern pieces whose shapes and joins produce the intended fit and volume.

**User-friendly description (it):** Trasforma un'idea di abbigliamento in pezzi di cartamodello che possano essere assemblati.

##### Drappeggiare il tessuto su un manichino

[drapeFabricOnAForm.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/designAndVisualCommunication/fashionAndApparelDesign/skills/drapeFabricOnAForm.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Shape and arrange fabric directly on a body or dress form to explore volume, folds and construction relationships in three dimensions.

**User-friendly description (it):** Disponi un tessuto su un corpo o un manichino per esplorare pieghe, vestibilità e volume.

##### Selezionare i tessuti per i capi

[selectTextilesForGarments.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/designAndVisualCommunication/fashionAndApparelDesign/skills/selectTextilesForGarments.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Choose fabric properties such as weight, drape, texture and opacity to serve a particular garment form and expressive intention.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scegli tessuti il cui peso, consistenza e drappeggio siano adatti al modello dell'indumento.

#### Identità grafica

Skills: 4

[graphicIdentity.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/designAndVisualCommunication/graphicIdentity/graphicIdentity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinctive visual signs and consistent combinations establish recognizable communication across formats.

**User-friendly description (it):** Costruisci identità visive riconoscibili attraverso scelte grafiche coordinate.

##### Adattare la grafica a diversi formati

[adaptGraphicsAcrossFormats.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/designAndVisualCommunication/graphicIdentity/skills/adaptGraphicsAcrossFormats.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Retain communicative priority when moving a design between sizes or media.

**User-friendly description (it):** Adatta un progetto grafico a dimensioni diverse senza perderne il messaggio.

##### Costruire un'identità visiva

[buildAVisualIdentity.data.ts](../../../content/art/data/skills/designAndVisualCommunication/graphicIdentity/skills/buildAVisualIdentity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Coordinate type, color and form into a consistent set of related expressions.

**User-friendly description (it):** Combina colori, caratteri e forme in un'identità visiva coerente.

##### Progettare un simbolo grafico

**User-friendly description (it):** Progetta un passaggio fluido o espressivo da uno stato animato a un altro.

Skills: 7
